news.title: Chennai’s top 100 property tax defaulters owe GCC ₹31 crore
news.para: The Chennai Corporation has unveiled a list identifying 100 significant property tax defaulters, who owe the civic authority more than ₹31 crore in total dues. Among them are key players from the infrastructure, real estate, and education sectors. Leading the charge is M/s IG3 Infra Limited, with a staggering ₹4.87 crore in unpaid taxes.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh government approves ₹943 crore for Harnandipuram land buy
news.para: The Uttar Pradesh government has given the green light for an investment of Rs 943 crore towards the Harnandipuram township project. This sum is intended for land acquisition and vital infrastructure enhancements. Previously, the Ghaziabad Development Authority allocated Rs 400 crore for initial infrastructure tasks. Due to rising land acquisition costs, the project timeline has been revised from 2024.

news.title: Unauthorised layout cannot be a ground for denying power connection: Andhra Pradesh HC
news.para: The Andhra Pradesh High Court declared that homeowners cannot be denied electricity connections, emphasizing that unauthorized layout status is insufficient grounds for refusal. A directive has been issued mandating the processing of domestic connection applications, reinforcing that property possession and valid title bolster an applicant's claims. Authorities are required to review these applications and issue orders within a three-week timeframe.

news.title: “Fraud on system”: SC-appointed committee on commercial activity in residential areas
news.para: A committee formed by the Supreme Court is advocating for a renewed effort to eliminate unsafe commercial structures. It aims to abolish mixed-use regulations that permit business activities within residential zones. Citing recent fire hazards and inadequate exit protocols from major markets, the committee urges local authorities to assess and address unauthorized commercial ventures. Additionally, the Delhi government needs to re-evaluate its bed and breakfast policy to curb potential abuses.

news.title: Delhi HC asks DDA to resume property conversion portal quickly
news.para: The Delhi High Court has raised concerns over more than 1,300 stalled property conversion applications, highlighting the situation's urgency. The Delhi Development Authority has already amassed over Rs 155 crore from these applications. Unfortunately, the Interactive Disposal of Land Information System portal has been down since January 2, 2026, significantly hindering property owners eager to complete sale transactions.

news.title: CenturyPly plans ₹2,500 crore investment to double turnover by 2031
news.para: CenturyPly plans to double its turnover to Rs 12,000 crore by 2031. The company will allocate Rs 2,500 crore over the next five years for establishing new plants in Uttar Pradesh and Odisha, while also upgrading current facilities to increase production capacity. In addition, CenturyPly is introducing a ten-year consumer assurance program to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.

news.title: West Bengal government to impose heavy fine for building plan violation post March 2027
news.para: Property owners are granted an extension until March 2027 to rectify deviations in their building plans. Following this deadline, substantial penalties will be enforced on commercial structures. In cases of major violations affecting safety, demolition could be the severe consequence. To maintain oversight, third-party agencies will monitor construction phases. Additionally, civic authorities are poised to implement stricter regulations regarding parking for commercial buildings.

news.title: Telangana RERA slaps penalty on developer, land owners for selling flat without registration
news.para: The Hyderabad RERA has launched penalty actions against a developer and the landowners for violating project sale rules. It was determined that sales were made prior to the project's essential registration with TG RERA. On the other hand, a request for a refund by the allottee was denied, as there was a registered sale deed that indicated ownership rights.

news.title: Telangana RERA slaps penalty on two real estate agents for selling plots in unregistered project
news.para: The TG RERA has initiated penalty proceedings against two agents involved in the unauthorized sale of plots. It has ordered the landowner to stop all marketing and selling activities until proper registration occurs. In one instance, a buyer invested over one crore rupees in a plot from the Amber Homes project, which is unregistered.

news.title: Deceased builder’s legal heirs can’t deny onus of delivering flats to buyers: NCDRC
news.para: In a decisive ruling, the National Consumer Commission has mandated that legal heirs must either provide flats or refund payments to homebuyers within six weeks. The heirs' claims of ignorance regarding the payments and ongoing civil suits were dismissed as baseless by the commission. The ruling reinforces that the failure to deliver possession creates an ongoing cause for legal action.

news.title: Gurugram civic body issues notices as C&D waste plant allegedly shuts out builders
news.para: The lone construction waste facility in Gurgaon has allegedly ceased accepting private debris, prompting heightened fears of illegal dumping in the area. To address this situation, the civic body has ordered the concessionaire to urgently recommence waste acceptance. Although the facility cites capacity issues, the civic body disagrees and warns that penalties and even contract termination could follow if the refusal of service persists.

news.title: Kalpataru's loss narrows to ₹27 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Realty firm Kalpataru Ltd reported a net loss of Rs 26.52 crore for the June quarter. Total income rose to Rs 495.04 crore in the April-June period. This compares to a net loss of Rs 49.42 crore in the prior year. The company has 85 completed projects and 30 ongoing developments. Its net debt stood at Rs 8,229 crore as of June 30, 2026.

news.title: Nexus Select Trust posts 11% increase in NOI to ₹510 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Nexus Select Trust reported an eleven percent increase in net operating income for the June quarter. The company distributed three hundred seventy crore rupees to its unit holders. It has identified eight shopping malls for potential future acquisition. This expansion aims to double the portfolio by the year 2030. The trust is acquiring Diamond Plaza mall in Kolkata.

news.title: DLF’s net profit rises 4% to ₹793.90 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: DLF's consolidated total income declined 46.1 per cent to ₹1,605.56 crore during the quarter. Its sales bookings stood at ₹657 crore, while its net cash position improved to ₹15,200 crore.

news.title: Jaipur development body temporarily halts action against 'illegal' commercial establishments
news.para: The Jaipur Development Authority has paused action against alleged illegal commercial establishments.  An Appellate Tribunal granted interim relief, staying notices until a final decision.  The tribunal set September 8 as the next hearing date for the matter.  This stay follows JDA issuing notices for violations of land-use norms.  The authority awaits the tribunal's final order on the construction legality.

news.title: Shivalik Small Finance Bank completes merger with ManiBhavnam Home Finance
news.para: Shivalik Small Finance Bank completed its acquisition of ManiBhavnam Home Finance India Pvt last week. This strategic merger cost the bank nearly one hundred and nine crore rupees. The deal establishes Shivalik's presence in the affordable housing finance market. ManiBhavnam brings a loan book of three hundred and twenty crore rupees to Shivalik. The bank plans fresh capital infusion to continue its growth trajectory.

news.title: Versova set to be new Bandra as builders line seafront with 35-floor luxury redevelopment towers
news.para: Versova is rapidly transforming from a quiet village into a luxury skyscraper enclave. Many housing societies are signing redevelopment deals with major builders for new towers. This redevelopment will introduce over 3,600 new apartments to the market within five years. Residents fear infrastructure strain from increased vehicles and services. The area's identity is shifting as new developments replace historical landmarks.

news.title: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty's profit rises 77% to ₹46 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Sri Lotus Developers reported a 77 percent net profit increase for the June quarter. Total income rose significantly to Rs 145.99 crore from Rs 68.09 crore. The company's pre-sales jumped 567 percent annually to Rs 409 crore. Sri Lotus Developers launched two new projects valued at Rs 1,350 crore. They have completed four projects and have multiple developments ongoing.

news.title: Land survey on; Dharani, Bhu Bharati inquiry will be on fast-track: Telangana minister
news.para: The government is investigating fraudulent land mutations and occupations on government property.  Land transactions from the Dharani and Bhu Bharati portals are being reviewed quickly.  Culprits involved in large-scale land fraud will face legal consequences.  Survey work is complete in 276 villages for assigning unique Bhoodhar numbers.  A comprehensive policy decision is needed for the state's 85,000 acres of assigned land.

news.title: Draft plan-2047 notified for Patliputra greenfield township; land transaction curbs lifted
news.para: Bihar government has notified the Draft Development Plan-2047 for Pataliputra Satellite Township. This move lifts land transaction restrictions, accelerating development and attracting investment. The draft plan invites public objections and suggestions within sixty days for finalization. This project aims to create a modern, sustainable urban center for future needs. The initiative aligns with the state's vision for planned and organized urban growth.
